biz.name: Dentizz Speciality Dental Care
biz.address: #10, Serpentine Street, Opp Blessington Apartment, Richmond Town, Bengaluru - 560 025
biz.intro: Dentizz is a speciality dental clinic in Richmond Town, Bengaluru, caring for children and adults with braces, aligners, root canals, crowns, dentures and more.
biz.mapQuery: Dentizz Speciality Dental Care, Serpentine Street, Richmond Town, Bengaluru

departments.name: Child dentistry
departments.summary: Gentle check-ups and everyday dental care for children.
departments.about: Child dentistry covers first visits, check-ups and everyday care for children, in a clinic with a kids' corner of its own.

departments.name: Orthodontics
departments.summary: Braces to straighten teeth, planned around your smile.
departments.about: Orthodontic treatment with braces to straighten teeth, planned around each patient's age and smile.

departments.name: Aligners
departments.summary: Clear aligners as an alternative to braces.
departments.about: Clear aligner treatment to straighten teeth, planned around each patient's smile.

departments.name: Crowns & bridges
departments.summary: Restore or replace damaged and missing teeth.
departments.about: Crowns protect damaged teeth and bridges close the gap left by missing teeth.

departments.name: Aesthetic dentistry
departments.summary: Restoring your smile is our speciality.
departments.about: Aesthetic treatments that restore and refresh the way your teeth look.

departments.name: Root canal treatment
departments.summary: Treatment for painful or infected teeth.
departments.about: Root canal treatment for teeth that are painful or infected, to save the tooth.

departments.name: Dentures
departments.about: Dentures replace several missing teeth so you can eat and smile with confidence.

departments.name: Wisdom tooth removal
departments.summary: Careful removal of troublesome wisdom teeth.
departments.about: Examination and, where needed, removal of wisdom teeth that hurt, swell or have no room.

departments.name: Check-up & scaling
departments.about: A routine dental examination and cleaning (scaling) to keep small problems small.

faq.a: Monday to Saturday, 10:30 am to 1:00 pm and 5:00 pm to 8:30 pm. On Fridays we are open from 5:00 pm to 8:30 pm only. The clinic is closed on Sundays.

faq.q: How do I book an appointment?
faq.a: Book online on our website, or call 98451 77371.
